The Lambda execution role must also have the logs:PutLogEvents permission for the log group to be created automatically.
The function must complete at least one successful invocation for the log group to be created automatically.
The successful invocation has to happen before the log group can be created automatically.
If any of the three conditions is missing, the function appears to run successfully, but no logs are written.
If any of the three conditions is missing, no error is surfaced.
The absence of logs is the only sign that something is wrong when any of the three conditions is missing.
The CloudWatch log group for a Lambda function is created automatically.

repair.regen_doc:
The CloudWatch log group for a Lambda function is created automatically only when all three conditions hold. First, the Lambda execution role must have the logs:CreateLogGroup permission. Second, the execution role must also have the logs:PutLogEvents permission. Third, the function must complete at least one successful invocation, and that invocation has to happen before the log group can be created automatically.

If any of these three conditions is missing, the function appears to run successfully, but no logs are written. No error is surfaced in that case, so the absence of logs is the only sign that something is wrong.
